summary: Completed end-to-end UI testing of the NUA marketing landing page. All 37 critical UI checks passed: landing page loads, all 14 sections render with correct data-testid attributes, sticky navbar scroll-blur effect works, hero CTA smooth-scrolls to #final-cta, 10 module cards render, Voice phrase rotation cycles correctly every ~3.6s, all 3 pricing tiers render (Growth elevated as featured), Final CTA headline and both CTAs render, Staff approve/dismiss buttons present, Footer with 3 social icons present, mobile viewport (390x844) collapses navbar with working mobile toggle drawer, no horizontal overflow, and zero console/page errors during full top-to-bottom scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: MeetAsh decision-feed entries, MultiLocation pulse points and Integrations brand badges do not expose per-item data-testid prefixes (ash-decision-N, map-pulse-N, integration-badge-N). Content was verified to exist via DOM counting (Executed/Approved/Suggested statuses present in Ash; 12 pulse points in MultiLocation > required 10; 45 brand items in Integrations > required 20; '18+ integrations' badge present), but adding per-item data-testid would improve automated testability.
Minor: Hero 'Watch Product Tour' button links to #voice (in-page anchor) rather than opening a real video modal — acceptable for static marketing page but worth noting.
Minor: Final CTA buttons have href='#' (anchor noop) — fine for landing-only build, but should hook up to a real demo/trial flow when backend integration arrives.
test_credentials: none required (no auth on landing page)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. No backend, no forms, no auth. All section data-testids match spec. Per-item testids missing on Ash decision feed, MultiLocation map pulses, and Integration brand badges if the next iteration adds new sub-assertions. Voice phrase rotation interval ~3.6s; allow 4-5s in waits.
